what: Mistake: my correction to job 20261024-154552-e65v required its test fixture and doc comment to name the operator/ directory, but xtask/tests/policy.rs bans that word in Athena's files, so the producer rightly used owner-notes/ and the criterion was judged unmet.
why: A correction or criterion that asks for text in Athena's files should be checked against the boundary scan's word list first (the earlier mistake on 2026-10-17 had the same cause).
